description: This file defines the PcreException class, a custom exception used within the Composer pcre library to handle PCRE (Perl Compatible Regular Expressions) errors, providing methods to create exceptions from failed pattern matches and to retrieve error messages.

classes.name: PcreException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending RuntimeException to handle PCRE related errors within Composer.

methods.name: fromFunction
methods.description: Creates a PcreException instance from a failed regex function call, including the function name and pattern involved.

methods.name: pcreLastErrorMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a human-readable error message corresponding to the last PCRE error code.
